info.name: Kiwi Trails API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for all 45 Kiwi Trails REST API endpoints. Includes environment variables, request bodies with examples from the API contract, and auto-token extraction scripts.

item.name: 01 - Accounts & Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, logout, and profile management.

request.description: Public · RegisterView. Creates a customer account (does not log the person in).
Public · LoginView. Deletes old token and creates new one valid for 24h. Saves token to {{token}}.
Public · LoginView for Admin. Deletes old token and creates new one valid for 24h. Saves admin token to {{token}}.
Logged in · LogoutView. Deletes the current authentication token.
Logged in · MeView. Retrieves the current logged in user profile.
Logged in · MeView. Updates full name, phone (or null to clear), or change password with current_password + new_password.

item.name: 02 - Tours & Catalog (Public)
item.description: Public browsing of tours, categories, and guides.

request.description: Public · TourListView. Lists active tours with average rating, review count, next departure, and seats left.
Public · TourDetailView. Retrieves full tour details, images, guide, faqs, and upcoming departures.
Public · CategoryListView. Returns all categories sorted by name.
Public · GuideDetailView. Retrieves guide profile, bio, languages list, and photo.

item.name: 03 - Tours & Catalog (Admin)
item.description: Admin catalog management: tours, image uploads, FAQs, guides, and categories.

request.description: Admin · AdminTourListCreateView. Lists all tours with optional status filter.

request.description: Admin · AdminTourListCreateView. Creates a new active tour.
Admin · AdminTourUpdateView. Updates specified tour fields.
Admin · AdminTourStatusView. Changes tour status to 'active' or 'archived'.
Admin · AdminTourImageCreateView. Uploads a JPG/PNG/WebP image up to 5MB.
Admin · AdminTourImageDeleteView. Deletes a tour image.
Admin · AdminFaqCreateView. Adds an FAQ entry to the tour.
Admin · AdminFaqDetailView. Updates an existing FAQ.
Admin · AdminFaqDetailView. Deletes an FAQ.
Admin · AdminGuideCreateView. Creates a new tour guide.
Admin · AdminGuideUpdateView. Updates guide details.
Admin · AdminCategoryCreateView. Creates a new category.

item.name: 04 - Departures & Calendar
item.description: Tour departures, monthly availability calendar, and admin departure scheduling.

request.description: Public · TourDepartureListView. Lists upcoming scheduled departures for a tour.
Public · DepartureCalendarView. Returns all scheduled departures for a month (YYYY-MM).
Admin · AdminDepartureCreateView. Schedules a new departure for a tour.
Admin · AdminDepartureUpdateView. Updates departure capacity or deadlines (capacity cannot drop below held seats).
Admin · AdminDepartureStatusView. Status 'completed' or 'cancelled'. 'completed' marks approved bookings as completed.

item.name: 05 - Reviews
item.description: Public tour reviews, customer review submission, and admin review moderation.

request.description: Public · TourReviewListView. Lists customer reviews for a tour, newest first.
Customer · ReviewCreateView. Submits a review for the caller's own completed booking.
Admin · AdminReviewListView. Admin view of all reviews with customer IDs and tour titles.

item.name: 06 - Coupons
item.description: Coupon validation for checkout and admin coupon management.

request.description: Customer · CouponValidateView. Verifies code, expiry, active status, and computes discount amount.
Admin · AdminCouponListCreateView. Lists all coupons newest first.
Admin · AdminCouponListCreateView. Creates a new percent or fixed discount coupon.
Admin · AdminCouponUpdateView. Updates coupon properties (code cannot be modified).

item.name: 07 - Bookings (Customer)
item.description: Customer booking preview, creation, listing, cancellation, PDF invoice, and calendar invite.

request.description: Customer · BookingQuoteView. Previews total price and discounts without booking seats.
Customer · BookingCreateView. Reserves seats and generates unique booking reference (KT-XXXXXX).
Customer · BookingMyListView. Retrieves the caller's bookings, newest first.
Owner or Admin · BookingDetailView. Retrieves booking details with cancellation status.
Owner · BookingCancelView. Cancels booking if before tour cancellation deadline.
Owner or Admin · BookingInvoiceView. Generates and downloads PDF tax invoice.
Owner · BookingCalendarView. Downloads iCalendar .ics event file.

item.name: 08 - Bookings & Operations (Admin)
item.description: Admin booking management, approvals, attendance tracking, and metrics dashboard.

request.description: Admin · AdminBookingListView. Lists bookings with customer details and attendance marks.
Admin · AdminBookingStatusView. Changes status (approved, rejected, cancelled, completed).
Admin · AdminAttendanceListView. Lists approved/completed bookings for attendance roll call.
Admin · AdminAttendanceUpdateView. Marks passenger status as 'present' or 'absent'.
Admin · AdminDashboardView. Returns active tours, upcoming departures, bookings by status, and total revenue.
